description: Na₄C₂O₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a square pyramidal geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.40 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.77 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.64 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one C and five O atoms. The Na-C bond length is 2.90 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.52 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two equivalent O atoms. Both C-O bond lengths are 1.31 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.29 Å) and two longer (1.30 Å) C-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one C atom.
